bio.text: Russell Bedsole, a Republican, has represented District 49 in the Alabama House of Representatives since December 2020 and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.
He earned a B.A. in criminal justice from Auburn University in 1998 and an M.S. in physician assistant studies from Troy University in 2005.
His career experience includes working as a captain in the Shelby County Sheriff's Office.
